_note: Who made each model the kit can fetch, and where, so an organisation that restricts models by origin can check without research. Publishers are as the model cards name them; countries are the publishers' home countries from public information, not from the cards, so confirm them in your own review. The revisions are pinned in the lock files named under `lock`. `setup` is the setup.sh option that fetches the model; `role` is what the kit uses it for.

models.made_by: Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud (MLX conversion by the mlx-community volunteers)
models.role: narration: the house voice, and the quick clone of your own voice

models.made_by: Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud (MLX conversion by mlx-community)
models.role: designing a new synthetic voice from a text description (how the house voice was made)
speech check: confirms each narrated line says what the script says
narration and training: a fine-tuned copy of your own voice
measuring how close a voice sounds to its reference recording

models.setup: ./setup.sh --music (optional; the kit ships a music bed)

narration_engines: Every way the kit can narrate today uses a model from China: Qwen3-TTS (house voice, quick clone) or VoxCPM2 (fine-tune). An organisation that blocks Chinese-origin models can't narrate with the kit yet; the rest (scripts, drawings, rendering, the speech check) doesn't depend on them.
